prompt: You write the TOPIC line of a short story for a benchmark: the general subject a reader who skimmed the story could name, in 4 to 8 words: the setting and the kind of situation. The benchmark asks about the story's people, so the line must not let a reader infer any of it: do NOT name or hint at any person's role, occupation or social position; any relationship between the people (family, friend, colleague, mentor, spouse, ...); any feeling, intention, belief or suspicion; or what anyone did to anyone. Leave out the telling details (objects, places or events that point to one person, relationship or act) and keep only the general subject. No names. Reply with the line only.
lint: no credit word of a varied axis (conjunctive) / no role term, story blocklist word or gold action form (role_bound); a hit is re-asked
